extracted_data.readability_issues: Net weight, MRP, Mfg Date, and Best Before field values are left blank on the package.

violations.message: Country of origin declaration is absent. Rule 6(1)(aa) of LM(PC) Rules requires this declaration on all packaged commodities; it is especially critical for imported goods.
violations.remedial_action: Print "Made in India" or the appropriate country of origin declaration on the package.

violations.message: Net quantity is absent or the numeric value could not be determined. Mandatory under Rule 6(1)(c) of LM(PC) Rules, 2011.
violations.remedial_action: Declare the net quantity with a numeric value and a standard SI unit on the package.

violations.rule: Month and Year of Manufacture / Packing / Import
violations.message: Month and year of manufacture, packing, or import is absent or illegible. Mandatory under Rule 6(1)(d) of LM(PC) Rules, 2011.
violations.remedial_action: Declare the month and year of manufacture or packing on the label (e.g. "Mfg: JAN 2024").

violations.message: "Best Before" or "Use By" date is absent. Rule 6(1)(da) of LM(PC) Rules mandates this declaration on all food products, cosmetics, and pharmaceutical packaged commodities.
violations.remedial_action: Print the expiry / "Best Before" date on the package in the format "BB: MM/YYYY" or "Exp: MM/YYYY".

violations.message: MRP declaration is absent or numeric value is zero. Mandatory under Rule 6(1)(e) of LM(PC) Rules, 2011.
violations.remedial_action: Print the MRP with the phrase "inclusive of all taxes" on the package.

violations.message: Unit Sale Price (₹ per g/ml or ₹ per kg/l) is not declared. The December 2022 amendment to Rule 6(11) makes USP mandatory on all pre-packaged commodities.
violations.remedial_action: Declare the Unit Sale Price (e.g. "₹ 8 per 100 g") on the package as per the Dec-2022 LM(PC) Amendment.

violations.message: Dimensions or sizes are not declared. Rule 6(1)(f) of LM(PC) Rules requires dimensional details on packages of items sold by size (sheets, wipes, bags, containers, fabrics).
violations.remedial_action: Declare the dimensions or size of the commodity on the label (e.g. "30 cm × 20 cm", "A4").

violations.rule: Consumer Care Contact Details — Completely Absent
violations.message: No consumer care contact details (phone, email, or address) are declared. Rule 6(2) of LM(PC) Rules mandates a consumer grievance contact on all packaged commodities.
violations.remedial_action: Print a consumer care phone number, email address, and postal address on the package.

violations.message: Readability issue detected: Net weight, MRP, Mfg Date, and Best Before field values are left blank on the package.. Rule 9 requires declarations to be legible, prominent, definite, plain, not obscured, and in high contrast to the background.
violations.remedial_action: Ensure all mandatory declarations are printed clearly with adequate contrast against the background.

violations.message: Mandatory declarations are scattered and not logically grouped together on the Principal Display Panel.
violations.remedial_action: Group the mandatory declarations (Commodity Name, Net Quantity, MRP, Date) closely together on the Principal Display Panel (PDP).
